title: compatible_genre_tempo_stable_beat
purpose: Compatible genre family, direct-tempo-compatible BPM, HIGH beat/downbeat confidence, HIGH analysis confidence -> dynamic mix (FULL_DJ_BLEND) may be eligible.

title: strongly_incompatible_genre_style
purpose: Genre families share no overlap even though BPM matches exactly and beat/downbeat/analysis confidence are all HIGH -- proves BPM alone never authorizes complex mixing (P5) and that genre incompatibility independently disables it, matching Apple's publicly documented 'some genres play without transitions'.

title: tempo_relation_requires_excessive_stretch
purpose: Genre-compatible, beat/downbeat confident, but the BPM relationship is neither direct nor a legitimate half/double-time relation -- required stretch exceeds MAX_JUSTIFIED_TEMPO_STRETCH_PCT -- proves tempo incompatibility alone disables complex mixing even with a compatible genre.

title: compatible_genre_tempo_dense_vocal_collision
purpose: Genre and tempo compatible, beat/downbeat confident, but dense vocal-on-vocal overlap risk is HIGH -- proves vocal collision independently downgrades an otherwise technically beat-compatible pair.

title: strong_energy_continuation_preferred_high_energy_candidate
purpose: Every hard-gating component passes AND energy continuity is STRONG with compatible structure -- the preferred high-energy-momentum candidate once timing/compatibility safety gates already passed (spec: energy is a ranking signal AFTER safety gates, never a substitute for them).
